hints.title: Directed Range Reachability
hints.text: Bomb A can detonate bomb B if the Euclidean distance between them does not exceed the blast radius of bomb A.

hints.title: Asymmetric Edge Construction
hints.text: Build a directed graph where edges exist only when the source radius covers the target coordinates.

hints.title: Exhaustive Component Exploration
hints.text: Run breadth-first search starting from each bomb individually and track the maximum reachable vertex count.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N^3) directed reachability graph and breadth-first search from each bomb
complexity.notes: Bomb explosion ranges define a directed graph because reachability is not symmetric.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Assuming reachability is symmetric fails because a large bomb can trigger a small bomb without the reverse holding.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constructing directed edges once allows independent BFS searches from each bomb origin.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should model directed explosion edges and find the maximum reachable component.
